items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach, exposing personal information belonging to more than one million students, parents, and teachers. If you or your family use Mathspace, be alert for phishing emails or suspicious contact using your personal details, as this information may now be in the hands of criminals.

More broadly, AI-powered scams are becoming increasingly convincing and harder to spot. Experts warn that AI can now mimic trusted contacts and craft highly personalised messages. Always verify unexpected requests — especially those involving money, logins, or personal information — by contacting the sender through a separate, known channel before responding.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
